components.title: Custom typed queue callback extension
components.summary: Adds a queue-domain selector and typed callback projection with focused queue-domain tests.

steps.description: Resolves the requested queue domain for a team-owned actor.
Applies the normal callback ownership boundary and returns the selected queue.
Returns the bounded queue size or a negative status.

facts.statement: Revision 7555c836e0457b04100b20149497d088dd9c2ca7 is reported as a direct child of upstream release revision 2639eedac7d1fd67d793ec93ebd27f014f336a14 with ten changed files, 286 insertions and 6 deletions. The indexed callbacks show the added typed queue-domain surface.
The typed queue callback refuses cheats, resolves through the current skirmish AI callback and returns only a selected team-owned queue domain.

A retained official stock executable and a later custom rally executable have distinct reported SHA-256 identities. Their custody, and this registered source revision, do not establish which engine artifact a current game process selected or loaded.

Later historical source revisions add a substantially broader atomic replacement and observer service. Source approval, focused tests and isolated build receipts remain separate from installation, runtime selection and native acceptance.

open_questions: Which source revision was used to build the artifact selected by the next native process?
